info.title: AGRIMAN Unified Platform - All Modules (Database: Farmersdb)
info.description:
### 🌾 Comprehensive Unified Farm Financial & Operations Platform API
Unified ASP.NET Core (.NET 8) platform storing all data in **`Farmersdb`** on `NIRANJAN\SQLEXPRESS`:

- **1. Auth & User API**: JWT Login, Registration, OTP Password Reset, Roles, Permissions
- **2. Farmer Registry**: Profiles, Aadhaar, Land Holding, Addresses, Bank Accounts
- **3. Farm Management**: Farms, Land Details, Survey Numbers, Soil Types, Irrigation, Documents
- **4. Income Management**: Categories, Transactions, Items, Payment Receipts
- **5. Purchases & Suppliers**: Vendor Profiles, Purchase Orders, Line Items, Disbursements
- **6. Inventory & Products**: Agricultural Inputs, Stock In/Out, Stock Adjustments
- **7. Expenses API**: Financial Ledger, Categories, Expense Items, Disbursements, CSV Export
- **8. Sales API**: Crop Sales Records, Analytics Summary, Auto Calculations, Seed Data
- **09. Purchases & Inward Orders**: Agricultural Purchase Orders, Vendor Invoices & Payments
- **10. Labour Management API**: Workers, Daily Attendance & Wage Disbursements
- **13. Machinery & Equipment API**: Farm Machinery Fleet, Lookups, Operating Expenses & ROI
- **14. Loan & Finance API**: Agricultural Loans, Repayment Schedules & EMI Calculator
- **15. Supplier Management API**: Agro-dealers, Purchase Invoices, Payments & Khata Ledger
- **16. Buyer Management API**: Wholesale Produce Buyers, Commission Agents & Receivables
- **00. Unified Overview**: Cross-module Total Data (`/api/total-data`) & System Health (`/api/health`)

**Database Server**: `NIRANJAN\SQLEXPRESS` | **Database**: `Farmersdb`

get.summary: Get paginated list of Farm Expenses with searching, category filtering, and UI workspace card metrics.
get.description:
Matches the **Workspace / Expenses** UI:
- Fast search across Expense No, Farmer, Farm, Crop, Supplier, Description, and Category
- Returns top 3 card statistics: `Total Records`, `Rows on Page`, `Matching Filters`
- Includes formatted currency ("₹18,500") and formatted dates ("22 Oct 2026")

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: General search term querying Expense No, Farmer, Farm, Crop, Supplier, Description, and Category.

parameters.name: ExpenseCategory
parameters.description: Specific category filter (e.g., Fertilizers, Labour, Seeds).

parameters.name: Farmer
parameters.description: Filter by Farmer name.

parameters.name: Farm
parameters.description: Filter by Farm name.

parameters.name: Crop
parameters.description: Filter by Crop name.

parameters.name: PaymentMode
parameters.description: Filter by payment mode (Cash, Bank, etc.).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter by status (Paid, Pending, Partially Paid).

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Filter by start date (inclusive).

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: Filter by end date (inclusive).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based index).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: Sort column (date, amount, expenseNo, farmer). Default is date descending.

parameters.name: SortDescending
parameters.description: Whether to sort in descending order (default: true).

parameters.name: ngrok-skip-browser-warning
parameters.description: Skip ngrok browser warning interstitial (default: true)

200.description: List of expense records and summary metrics

post.summary: Add a new Expense record (matches "Add Expenses record" modal UI).
post.description:
- Auto-generates `ExpenseNo` (e.g., `EXP-2026-0099`) if not provided.
- Defaults `ExpenseDate` to today if not provided.
- Links or resolves `ExpenseCategory` with `expense_categories` lookup.
- Automatically registers an entry in `expense_payments` ledger.
- Creates line items in `expense_items` if supplied.

parameters.name: ngrok-skip-browser-warning
parameters.description: Skip ngrok browser warning interstitial (default: true)

AuthResponseDto.description: Generic API response for Authentication endpoints

items.description: Optional multi-item lines. When omitted, a single SalesItem is automatically created from Crop/Quantity/Unit/Rate.

initialPaymentAmount.description: Optional initial payment amount received at the time of sale entry.

ExpenseCategoryCreateRequest.description: Request to create a new expense category.

ExpenseCategoryUpdateRequest.description: Request to update an existing expense category.

expenseDate.description: Date of the expense transaction (e.g., 2026-10-22). If omitted, defaults to today.

expenseNo.description:
Unique expense voucher number (e.g. EXP-2026-0098).
If left empty, system automatically generates the next sequential number.

farmer.description: Name of the farmer incurring or managing the expense.

farm.description: Farm or field parcel name where expenditure was utilized.

crop.description: Crop for which the expense was incurred.

expenseCategory.description: Category of expense (e.g., Fertilizers, Labour, Seeds, Machinery, Pesticides).

categoryId.description: Optional foreign key to registered ExpenseCategory entity.

supplier.description: Vendor, contractor, supplier, or labor provider name.

description.description: Detailed description or memo of items/services purchased.

paymentMode.description: Mode of payment: Cash, Bank, UPI, Cheque, Card.

referenceNo.description: Payment reference or transaction ID (e.g. UTR-09133, cheque number, UPI ref).

remarks.description: Additional notes, season stage, or internal remarks.

status.description: Expense payment status: Paid, Pending, Partially Paid. Defaults to "Paid".

items.description: Optional line item breakdown for individual products/services in this expense.

ExpenseCreateRequest.description: Request model for adding a new farm expense (matches "Add Expenses record" modal UI).

ExpenseDetailResponse.description: Full detail response model for an expense transaction including items and payments.

ExpenseItemDto.description: DTO for child expense line-items (fertilizer bags, seed packets, labour count).

ExpenseListItemResponse.description: Response item tailored for the Expenses table grid in the UI.

ExpenseListItemResponsePagedResult.description: Generic paginated response wrapper containing dataset and UI header metrics.

ExpensePaymentDto.description: DTO for child expense payment records.

rowsOnPage.description: Total rows displayed on the current page (Card 2).

matchingFilters.description: Total records matching active filter/search criteria (Card 3).

totalAmount.description: Total aggregated expense amount across the filtered records.

ExpenseSummaryMetricsDto.description: Workspace summary metrics for the three top UI cards.

ExpenseUpdateRequest.description: Request model for updating an existing expense transaction.

LoginRequestDto.description: Screen 1 - Login Request supporting either Mobile or Email

LogoutRequestDto.description: Logout request (optional refresh token to revoke; if omitted, revokes all active tokens for user)

name.description: Full Name of the User (e.g. Arjun Mehta). Also accepts "fullName".

fullName.description: Alias for Name (used by frontend auth.js)

phoneNumber.description: Alias for MobileNumber (used by frontend auth.js)

confirmPassword.description: Optional Confirmation Password (if supplied, must match Password)

RegisterRequestDto.description: User Registration Request (supports both Name/MobileNumber and FullName/PhoneNumber aliases)

Bearer.description: Paste your JWT bearer token directly (without 'Bearer '). Swagger will include it in the Authorization header.
